header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation received.
body: This petition was filed in the year 2021 and was lastly fixed on 20.10.2021, but thereafter no efforts were made to proceed with the petition, which reflects that petitioner and his counsel has lost interest to pursue the same.
Under these circumstances, this petition is dismissed for nonprosecution.
